Overview

LLP Registration in Noida

Noida's consultants, architects, designers, IT service providers, CA and law practices and family-run service businesses often prefer an LLP: it gives limited liability and a separate legal identity like a company, but without mandatory audit below the thresholds, board meetings or an AGM. Two professionals sharing an office in Sector 18 or a team of freelancers in Sector 62 can run an LLP with very little ongoing paperwork.

The incorporation is processed online by the MCA. The local details — a Noida address proof that matches exactly, Uttar Pradesh stamp paper for the LLP Agreement, and Form 3 filed within 30 days — are what make the difference between a clean registration and months of resubmissions. We take care of all of it.

Noida specifics

What is specific to Noida

  • ROC Kanpur is your Registrar; Form 11 and Form 8 are filed there every year.
  • LLP Agreement on Uttar Pradesh stamp paper — the duty depends on the partners' contribution, and the agreement must be filed in Form 3 within 30 days of incorporation.
  • Registered office in a Noida flat or co-working space is acceptable with the owner's NOC and a recent PVVNL or NPCL bill.
  • Professional practices (CA, CS, architecture, legal) should check their regulator's rules on practising through an LLP; we advise on the structure.
  • Uttar Pradesh GST registration after incorporation if your turnover or activity requires it.

For the full legal detail — eligibility, benefits, comparison tables and law — see the main LLP Registration guide. This page covers what changes when your registered office is in Noida.

Checklist

Documents required in Noida

For each partner

  • PAN card and Aadhaar card
  • Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence
  • Latest bank statement or utility bill (not older than 2 months)
  • Passport-size photograph
  • Email ID and mobile number

Noida registered office

  • Latest electricity bill (PVVNL / NPCL), gas, telephone or mobile bill — not older than 2 months
  • NOC from the property owner
  • Rent agreement, if rented or in a co-working space
  • Allotment letter, sale deed or property tax receipt, if self-owned
Step by step

LLP Registration process in Noida

Digital Signature Certificates Day 1–2

Class-3 DSCs for the designated partners via Aadhaar eKYC.

Name reservation — RUN-LLP Day 2–5

Name and trademark check, then reservation with up to two name choices.

Incorporation filing — FiLLiP Day 5–9

FiLLiP filed with partner details, Noida registered office proof and consents; DPIN allotted.

Certificate of Incorporation Day 9–12

COI with LLPIN, plus the LLP's PAN and TAN.

LLP Agreement & Form 3 Within 30 days

Agreement drafted and executed on Uttar Pradesh stamp paper of the correct value, then filed in Form 3.

Bank account & registrations After COI

Current account, and GST or MSME registration if needed.

FAQs

LLP Registration in Noida — common questions

What is the cost of LLP registration in Noida?

Professional fee from ₹1,499, plus Digital Signatures, MCA fees based on contribution and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty on the LLP Agreement. We give an itemised written quote first.

LLP or Pvt Ltd for a Noida IT services business?

If you will raise investment or want to issue ESOPs, choose a Private Limited Company. If you want low compliance, no mandatory audit below ₹40 lakh turnover or ₹25 lakh contribution, and flexible profit sharing, an LLP fits. We help you decide on a free call.

How long does LLP registration take in Noida?

Typically 10–15 working days from complete documents, followed by execution and filing of the LLP Agreement within 30 days of incorporation.

Can the LLP's registered office be a Greater Noida West society flat?

Yes, with a recent utility bill, the owner's NOC and, if rented, the rent agreement.

Does a Noida LLP need an audit?

Only if its turnover exceeds ₹40 lakh or its contribution exceeds ₹25 lakh in the financial year. Below these limits, only Form 11, Form 8 and the income tax return are required each year.
